lightmap.options.minimap.show.tooltip: Draws the minimap in the top-left corner. The map is recorded either way.
lightmap.options.minimap.opacity.tooltip: How solid the minimap is. Lower values let the game show through; at 0% it is not drawn.
lightmap.options.minimap.size.tooltip: Side of the minimap in screen pixels. It stays the same size at any GUI scale.
lightmap.options.minimap.rotate.tooltip: Turns the minimap so the direction you look is up. Off keeps north up.
lightmap.marker.name: Name
